finding: F2 selection record section 12.5 row 4; 05-work-agents-skills.md section 9
case: A trial interest declaring a writer key over an existing sole-writer kind.
why: Section 12.5 row 4 and AS-M5-02: an interest that can declare its own writer key takes custody of a kind by asserting it. The mutation deletes the emptiness requirement and leaves the external-authority conjunct, so the guard still mentions writer-key authority while permitting the interest to name its own.
